digest.component_or_area: bridge provider test harness (git subprocess isolation)
propositions: test_five_environment_matrix_has_identical_results_without_gh fails on dev hosts with ambient GIT_CONFIG_* command-scope injection (safe.bareRepository=explicit) but passes in CI where those env vars are absent

bridge harness git()/bare_git() helpers inherit os.environ wholesale, allowing injected safe.bareRepository=explicit to poison bare repository operations with 'fatal: cannot use bare repository' error
unsetting GIT_CONFIG_COUNT/KEY_*/VALUE_* env vars discriminatingly flips all 5 matrix parameters from fail to pass on the same tree, proving ambient injection is the root cause not gh itself

21 total test failures span three test files (test_bridge_provider_wrappers_heldout.py, test_run_reconcile_bridge_heldout.py, test_bridge_runner_install_paths_heldout.py) on hostile dev hosts via the same harness git-config inheritance gap

fix must scrub GIT_CONFIG_COUNT/KEY_*/VALUE_*/PARAMETERS from harness helpers and runner_env, pin GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null and GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1, and monkeypatch the hostile injection into the matrix test to make regression deterministic in CI
